versos.hebraico: אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן פָּתַ֤ח אִיּוֹב֙ אֶת־פִּ֔יהוּ וַיְקַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־יוֹמֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.
controles.kjv: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.
controles.livre: Depois disto Jó abriu sua boca, e amaldiçoou seu dia.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

controles.web: Job answered:
controles.kjv: And Job spake, and said,
controles.livre: Pois Jó respondeu, e disse:

versos.hebraico: יֹ֣אבַד י֭וֹם אִוָּ֣לֶד בּ֑וֹ וְהַלַּ֥יְלָה אָ֝מַ֗ר הֹ֣רָה גָֽבֶר׃

controles.web: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’
controles.kjv: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.
controles.livre: Pereça o dia em que nasci, e a noite em que se disse: Um homem foi concebido.

versos.hebraico: הַיּ֥וֹם הַה֗וּא יְֽהִ֫י חֹ֥שֶׁךְ אַֽל־יִדְרְשֵׁ֣הוּ אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמָּ֑עַל וְאַל־תּוֹפַ֖ע עָלָ֣יו נְהָרָֽה׃

controles.web: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.
controles.kjv: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.
controles.livre: Torne-se aquele dia em trevas; Deus não lhe dê atenção desde acima, nem claridade brilhe sobre ele.

versos.hebraico: יִגְאָלֻ֡הוּ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְ֭צַלְמָוֶת תִּשְׁכָּן־עָלָ֣יו עֲנָנָ֑ה יְ֝בַעֲתֻ֗הוּ כִּֽמְרִ֥ירֵי יֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes black the day terrify it.
controles.kjv: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.
controles.livre: Reivindiquem-no para si trevas e sombra de morte; nuvens habitem sobre ele; a escuridão do dia o espante.

versos.hebraico: הַלַּ֥יְלָה הַהוּא֮ יִקָּחֵ֪ה֫וּ אֹ֥פֶל אַל־יִ֭חַדְּ בִּימֵ֣י שָׁנָ֑ה בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר יְ֝רָחִ֗ים אַל־יָבֹֽא׃

controles.web: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.
controles.kjv: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.
controles.livre: Tome a escuridão aquela noite; não seja contada entre os dias do ano, nem faça parte do número dos meses.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֤ה הַלַּ֣יְלָה הַ֭הוּא יְהִ֣י גַלְמ֑וּד אַל־תָּבֹ֖א רְנָנָ֣ה בֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.
controles.kjv: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.
controles.livre: Ah se aquela noite fosse solitária, e música de alegria não viesse a ela!

versos.hebraico: יִקְּבֻ֥הוּ אֹרְרֵי־י֑וֹם הָ֝עֲתִידִ֗ים עֹרֵ֥ר לִוְיָתָֽן׃

controles.web: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.
controles.kjv: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.
controles.livre: Amaldiçoem-na os que amaldiçoam o dia, os que se preparam para levantar seu pranto.

versos.hebraico: יֶחְשְׁכוּ֮ כּוֹכְבֵ֪י נִ֫שְׁפּ֥וֹ יְקַו־לְא֥וֹר וָאַ֑יִן וְאַל־יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה בְּעַפְעַפֵּי־שָֽׁחַר׃

controles.web: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,
controles.kjv: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:
controles.livre: Escureçam-se as estrelas de sua manhã; espere a luz, e não venha, e as pálpebras não vejam o amanhecer;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א סָ֭גַר דַּלְתֵ֣י בִטְנִ֑י וַיַּסְתֵּ֥ר עָ֝מָ֗ל מֵעֵינָֽי׃

controles.web: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.
controles.kjv: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.
controles.livre: Pois não fechou as portas do ventre onde eu estava, nem escondeu de meus olhos o sofrimento.

versos.hebraico: לָ֤מָּה לֹּ֣א מֵרֶ֣חֶם אָמ֑וּת מִבֶּ֖טֶן יָצָ֣אתִי וְאֶגְוָֽע׃

controles.web: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?
controles.kjv: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
controles.livre: Por que eu não morri desde a madre, ou perdi a vida ao sair do ventre?

versos.hebraico: מַ֭דּוּעַ קִדְּמ֣וּנִי בִרְכָּ֑יִם וּמַה־שָּׁ֝דַ֗יִם כִּ֣י אִינָֽק׃

controles.web: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?
controles.kjv: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
controles.livre: Por que joelhos me receberam? E por que seios me amamentaram?

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־עַ֭תָּה שָׁכַ֣בְתִּי וְאֶשְׁק֑וֹט יָ֝שַׁ֗נְתִּי אָ֤ז׀ יָנ֬וּחַֽ לִֽי׃

controles.web: For now should I have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,
controles.kjv: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,
controles.livre: Pois agora eu jazeria e repousaria; dormiria, e então haveria repouso para mim;

versos.hebraico: עִם־מְ֭לָכִים וְיֹ֣עֲצֵי אָ֑רֶץ הַבֹּנִ֖ים חֳרָב֣וֹת לָֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;
controles.kjv: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;
controles.livre: Com os reis e os conselheiros da terra, que edificavam para si os desertos;

versos.hebraico: א֣וֹ עִם־שָׂ֭רִים זָהָ֣ב לָהֶ֑ם הַֽמְמַלְאִ֖ים בָּתֵּיהֶ֣ם כָּֽסֶף׃

controles.web: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
controles.kjv: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
controles.livre: Ou com os príncipes que tinham ouro, que enchiam suas casas de prata.

versos.hebraico: א֤וֹ כְנֵ֣פֶל טָ֭מוּן לֹ֣א אֶהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝עֹלְלִ֗ים לֹא־רָ֥אוּ אֽוֹר׃

controles.web: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.
controles.kjv: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.
controles.livre: Ou por que não fui como um aborto oculto, como as crianças que nunca viram a luz?

versos.hebraico: שָׁ֣ם רְ֭שָׁעִים חָ֣דְלוּ רֹ֑גֶז וְשָׁ֥ם יָ֝נ֗וּחוּ יְגִ֣יעֵי כֹֽחַ׃

controles.web: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.
controles.kjv: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.
controles.livre: Ali os maus deixam de perturbar, e ali repousam os cansados de forças.

versos.hebraico: יַ֭חַד אֲסִירִ֣ים שַׁאֲנָ֑נוּ לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ ק֣וֹל נֹגֵֽשׂ׃

controles.web: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.
controles.kjv: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.
controles.livre: Ali os prisioneiros juntamente repousam; e não ouvem a voz do opressor.

versos.hebraico: קָטֹ֣ן וְ֭גָדוֹל שָׁ֣ם ה֑וּא וְ֝עֶ֗בֶד חָפְשִׁ֥י מֵאֲדֹנָֽיו׃

controles.web: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.
controles.kjv: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.
controles.livre: Ali estão o pequeno e o grande; e o servo livre está de seu senhor.

versos.hebraico: לָ֤מָּה יִתֵּ֣ן לְעָמֵ֣ל א֑וֹר וְ֝חַיִּ֗ים לְמָ֣רֵי נָֽפֶשׁ׃

controles.web: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
controles.kjv: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;
controles.livre: Por que se dá luz ao sofredor, e vida aos amargos de alma,

versos.hebraico: הַֽמְחַכִּ֣ים לַמָּ֣וֶת וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וַֽ֝יַּחְפְּרֻ֗הוּ מִמַּטְמוֹנִֽים׃

controles.web: Who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,
controles.kjv: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;
controles.livre: Que esperam a morte, e ela não chega, e que a buscam mais que tesouros;

versos.hebraico: הַשְּׂמֵחִ֥ים אֱלֵי־גִ֑יל יָ֝שִׂ֗ישׂוּ כִּ֣י יִמְצְאוּ־קָֽבֶר׃

controles.web: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
controles.kjv: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
controles.livre: Que saltam de alegram e ficam contentes quando acham a sepultura?

versos.hebraico: לְ֭גֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר־דַּרְכּ֣וֹ נִסְתָּ֑רָה וַיָּ֖סֶךְ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בַּעֲדֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
controles.kjv: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?
controles.livre: E também ao homem cujo caminho é oculto, e a quem Deus o encobriu?

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־לִפְנֵ֣י לַ֭חְמִי אַנְחָתִ֣י תָבֹ֑א וַֽיִּתְּכ֥וּ כַ֝מַּ֗יִם שַׁאֲגֹתָֽי׃

controles.web: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.
controles.kjv: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.
controles.livre: Pois antes do meu pão vem meu suspiro; e meus gemidos correm como águas.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד פָּ֭חַדְתִּי וַיֶּאֱתָיֵ֑נִי וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָ֝גֹ֗רְתִּי יָ֣בֹא לִֽי׃

controles.web: For the thing which I fear comes on me, That which I am afraid of comes to me.
controles.kjv: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
controles.livre: Pois aquilo eu temia tanto veio a mim, e aquilo que tinha medo me aconteceu.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֤א שָׁלַ֨וְתִּי׀ וְלֹ֖א שָׁקַ֥טְתִּי וְֽלֹא־נָ֗חְתִּי וַיָּ֥בֹא רֹֽגֶז׃פ

controles.web: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither have I rest; but trouble comes.”
controles.kjv: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.
controles.livre: Não tenho tido descanso, nem tranquilidade, nem repouso; mas perturbação veio sobre mim.
